name: G2
requirements: B2B only — 'G2 does not accept business-to-consumer (B2C) products or products that are currently in the alpha or beta stage of development.'
Submit via the Product Submission Form at g2.com/products/new; G2's research team verifies eligibility and categorization (~3-5 business days) before placing it.
After the profile is live, claim it ('Unclaimed' → 'Claim this profile'); claim review takes 1–3 business days.
One G2 listing per product for software companies; service providers get one profile per vendor. Profile names must be the real product/company name — no descriptions, marketing language, or symbols.
preparation: Check whether G2 already auto-created a listing under a different name first.
Product description, key features, customer value text (up to ~500 words for Profile Details).
Logo file; screenshots and video for a complete profile.
my.G2 access via LinkedIn, Facebook, Google, or business email.
workflow: Search g2.com for the product — claim it if already listed.
Wait for the research team's conditional approval (~3-5 business days) — the profile goes live and is claimable.
Claim the profile (1-3 business days for final approval).
Complete the profile in my.G2 → Product Profile → Product Information (logo, details, screenshots, pricing); optionally 'Optimize for SEO' AI-enhanced text.
Collect reviews; consider paid Seller plans only if needed (profile itself is free).
watchFor: Alpha/beta and B2C products are refused outright — don't submit pre-launch.
Claiming is a second review gate after profile creation.
Category placement is decided by G2's research team — you propose, they dispose.
my.G2 upsells (badges, analytics, buyer intent) are paid — a free profile is fully sufficient for a listing.
Post-2026 acquisition, Capterra/GetApp/Software Advice are managed from a separate G2 Digital Markets cabinet — different portal, not shared with G2.
countsAsLive: A public g2.com/products/<slug> page marked Claimed (or Unclaimed but visible) with reviews capability — verified once the research team approves and the profile resolves publicly.
unknowns: Whether products in public beta-with-pricing edge cases pass review.
